canvas.editor.tutorial.text.text_2:
Separate each verse with a line. 
For sections longer than 10s with no vocals, leave a blank line and it will be counted as an instrumental part.

Feel free to use the player in the bottom to assist you.
canvas.editor.tutorial.text_1.text_3:
Play the song using the player. 

While it's playing, press the DOWN arrow in the exact moment that the singer starts singing the verse. If you make any mistakes, press the up arrow to undo.
canvas.editor.tutorial.text_1.text_4:
When done, press the Submit button.
Your work will be auto-saved, so feel free to take a break and come back whenever.

canvas.calibration.windowsadvice.div.ste: Press Win+R in your keyboard, type mmsys.cpl, and hit enter.

Go to the Advanced tab, and uncheck "Disable audio enhancements", IF its there.
